reviews.comment: Such a sweet lady! She definitely prepares you well for all exams, both from her slides and the practice exam. Anytime I had questions, she would always email me back quickly. Highly recommend for an easy math class.

Really boring class. She doesn't make the slides, the department does so it's kinda odd that way. Easy class, studied under 24 hrs before the exams and ended class with a 97. Sweet professor who happens to teach a boring subject. Gives extra credit & pop quizzes for attendance in class (all on canvas tho so low key just watch for them). Easy class

Prof. Nugent was one of my favorite professors. She is so sweet and caring. She 3 tests that don't get dropped, but there are extra credit opportunities and all of the tests are very reasonable. You can easily get an A as long as you study!
dr. nugent is really good at teaching stats. she allows a cheat sheet for the final. exams are similar to practice exams. offers extra credit quite often. honeslty made learning stat very simple.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Extremely nice, class isnt bad, final has cheat sheet, extra credit is good, attendance is semi mandatory due to in class quizzes (some get dropped i believe). I didnt go to class too often but I still made a good grade due to her slides. Just attend class and pay attention and you should be good tho. Care for weekly homeworks tho (not on canvas)
Super easy professor. I normally am not a math person but passed her class with an 94!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Hands down the best stats prof. Very caring, clear explanations. Answers questions well and doesn't mind repeating.

Exam 3 dropped my grade to a B, so be careful. Can make cheat sheets and turn them in for EC. Weekly homework, but exam heavy. Exams are MCQ and fill in the blank. Use study guides to see what need for cheat sheets. For cheat sheet, write down definitions, rules, and commands. Exams aren't like homework. Good prof who knows what she's talking about

Honestly I forgot I was even taking this class until like the last month. The only work she gives is one homework like every 3 weeks, a super easy quiz, and then studying. The STAT exams are common exams but they are SOOO easy. She is really nice and brought us candy on halloween. Gave her a 4 because she doesn't teach super well but its chill.

This class was very easy, and Dr. Nugent is a great professor. Sometimes her lectures can be repetitive with examples but she gives you everything you need to succeed in this class and beyond. Definitely reach out to her if you're struggling in this course, she's very nice and good at filling in the gap of where you may have made a mistake.

Genuinely a great professor and person, I had a lot of support from her taking this class. Super sweet, def go to her office hours if you need help. TA also did review sessions day before the exam going over the practice exam and any other questions which prepared me for the exams really well. If you want to take this class, def take her!

You can tell by her lectures that she is incredibly intelligent and knowledgeable about statistics. Plenty of opportunities to ask questions and verify that your answers are correct. The practice exams cover almost everything you will see on the real exams. Beware however that the exam difficulty does increase as the semester goes on.

Not a bad class. The professor is kind and approachable. Homework can be a bit hard, but allows multiple attempts, and we get a cheat sheet on exams. My only issue is no grade rounding, even when I was less than 0.5 points from an A.

Ciara Nugent is clear, organized, and fair. Lectures emphasize practice over memorization, and homework closely matches exam material. There are practice exams, a final review, and test extra credit opportunities, which help a lot. Exams are straightforward if you keep up with the practice exams.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Very kind and approachable professor! Class is organized well and had minimal homework. There were 2 midterm exams, and then a final exam in which she allowed us a double-sided cheat sheet.
Her class is very easy to follow and stays within general topics. She provides manageable amounts of homework and let us have a cheat sheet for the final.

I enjoyed taking this class. She was kind and approachable. Her lectures never felt overly boring and made the material easier to follow. The course had manageable homework, two exams, and a final. She provided exam reviews that helped. There were extra credit opportunities. A cheat sheet was allowed on the final. She has a well-organized class.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class
